items.question: Which bodily locations are specified for placement in this nyāsa sequence?
premises: The head is named as a location of placement.
The pair of eyes is named as a location of placement.
The end of the face and the heart are likewise named as locations of placement.
items.inference: The nyāsa sequence assigns placement to the head, the two eyes, the end of the face, and the heart.
uncertainties: The exact anatomical referent of sumukhānte in this ritual context is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: One should place them on the head, on the pair of eyes, likewise at the end of the face, and on the heart.
